description: This open access dataset accompanies TODOS (Thermal sensOr Data-driven Occupancy Estimation System for Smart Buildings), a framework that estimates room occupancy with low-cost, low-power thermal sensor arrays combined with passive infrared sensors while preserving privacy. The data are sensor logs per room, identified by node, which users must pass through thermal background estimation and background subtraction and then concatenate according to the given sensor arrangement; the authors report occupancy detection accuracy of 98 to 100 per cent in their deployments, a method for treating the whole monitored area as one thermal image to avoid over- and under-counting with overlapping sensors, and a data augmentation technique to generate training data for rooms of other sizes and shapes. Coverage: the rooms instrumented in the study (location not stated on the page). Access: IEEE DataPort open access with a free account (created September 2023, last updated May 2026, DOI 10.21227/y3dv-8b19). Licence: not shown on the page read. Caveats: pre-processing steps must be reproduced from the cited method paper before use. Simulation uses: occupancy-driven HVAC control and occupancy models for building energy simulation. Related records: the Berkeley Sutardja Dai Hall room sensors and the ASHRAE Global Occupant Behavior Database.
